paragraphs.source_en: It was one of the first explorations to this area, and I had Hiroko Ai at my side, and we looked down into this canyon, its floor bare and flat, and she said to me, It's like the floor of a room." He stared at the audience, trying to remember Hiroko's face. Yes. . . no. Strange how one remembered faces until you tried to look at them in your mind, when they turned away from you. "I've missed her. I come here, and it's impossible to believe it's the same place, and so. . . it's hard to believe I ever really knew her." He paused, tried to focus on their faces. "Do you understand?"
